post.description:
Register a sale/purchase invoice as one balanced posted entry.

The client sends what a paper invoice carries; the debit/credit mapping is
derived here from the chart of accounts (1040/4010 for sales,
1030/2010 for purchases) and the line detail is stored in the entry
metadata.

``Idempotency-Key`` makes retries safe: a repeated click or a retried
request returns the invoice already registered instead of posting a second
entry for the same paper invoice.

get.description:
فاکتور فروش — the printed document of one registered invoice entry.

Same branded header as the proforma (logo + V.I.R.A), rendered from the
invoice detail the entry already carries. WeasyPrint's native libraries are
optional, so the very same HTML is returned when PDF is unavailable and the
browser's «چاپ → ذخیره به‌عنوان PDF» still works.

put.description: Edit an invoice-shaped entry; the server re-derives its balanced splits.

post.description: Return a posted entry to draft so it can be corrected («برگشت از ثبت»).

AccountLedgerRow.title: AccountLedgerRow
AccountLedgerRow.description: One posted movement on an account — the drill-down behind a statement line.

InvoiceCreate.title: InvoiceCreate
InvoiceCreate.description:
Invoice-shaped entry — the server derives the double-entry itself.

The user fills what a paper invoice has (date, seller, buyer, lines); the
chart-of-accounts mapping stays a server decision so the ledger's balance
invariant is never exposed as a form field.

InvoiceEntryUpdate.title: InvoiceEntryUpdate
InvoiceEntryUpdate.description: Edit of an invoice-shaped entry: the server re-derives the splits.

InvoiceLineIn.title: InvoiceLineIn
InvoiceLineIn.description: One invoice row the user actually sees: title, count, price.

JournalEntryUpdate.title: JournalEntryUpdate
JournalEntryUpdate.description:
An edit of an existing entry — status is preserved, history is versioned.

``splits`` replaces the entry's lines (double-entry validated as on create);
omit it to change only the date/description/counterparty. ``version_id``
turns the call into an optimistic-concurrency update.

OrderItemIn.title: OrderItemIn
OrderItemIn.description:
A line the user writes on the order page.

The product is chosen from the warehouse (``inventory_item_id``); its name
defaults to that item's name. Grams and print hours are no longer asked on
the order page (item 3) — they belong to the production job.

OrderProductionResult.title: OrderProductionResult
OrderProductionResult.description: Outcome of «افزودن به خط تولید» — created jobs plus honest warnings.

OrderSummary.title: OrderSummary
OrderSummary.description: Counts across all orders, independent of the recent-orders page limit.

ProductionFilamentIn.title: ProductionFilamentIn
ProductionFilamentIn.description: One spool consumed by a job, with its own grams and price per gram.
